caption:
Your family biodata should stay private to your own phone or computer.

When writing a marriage biodata, you share personal history, family background, and photographs. You shouldn't have to upload those files or register an account just to format a single document.

RishtaPatra is built local-first: every detail, photo and imported resume is processed in the browser and saved only on the device; an account is optional.

Keep your personal details right where they belong while preparing for a rishta.

Build your biodata at rishtapatra.com
